title: Memory Analysis and Consolidation
summary: This module provides functions for analyzing memory content to determine its scope, categories, and importance for storage, and for consolidating new memory with existing records.

nodes.label: Analyze for Save
nodes.title: Analyze Memory for Saving
nodes.description: Infers the scope, categories, importance, and metadata for a new memory entry using an LLM, returning a MemoryAnalysis object. Handles LLM failures by returning safe defaults.

nodes.label: Analyze for Consolidation
nodes.title: Analyze Memory for Consolidation
nodes.description: Determines how to consolidate new memory content with existing similar records (insert, update, or delete) using an LLM. Returns a ConsolidationPlan, defaulting to inserting new content on failure.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various Large Language Models (LLMs) for processing and generating text.

groups.label: Memory Analysis
groups.title: Memory Analysis Functions
groups.description: Functions responsible for analyzing memory content to extract relevant metadata and determine consolidation strategies.
